tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search Standard Blanks' blank apparel by keywords and filters. Returns up to 20 products with name, brand, slug, the lowest single-unit price ("from" price, in cents), availability, image and product page URL. When the query names a color or size, matchedColors lists the colors of that style that match (best first) and url opens the page on that color; an empty matchedColors for a query that named a color means that style is not sold in it. signal reports typo corrections and any words the search had to drop. Use the slug with get_product.

query.description: Keywords: brand, style number or product words, e.g. 'heavyweight hoodie' or 'bella canvas 3001'.

size.description: Only styles offered in this size.

max_price.description: Highest single-unit price, in US dollars.

min_price.description: Lowest single-unit price, in US dollars.

weight.description: Fabric weight band (ultralight 0-4 oz, light 4-5 oz, standard 5-6 oz, mid-heavy 6-7 oz, heavy 7-9 oz, heavyweight 9+ oz).

decoration.description: Only styles rated good or best for this decoration method (screen print, DTG, embroidery, sublimation, heat-transfer vinyl, discharge, DTF).

similar_to.description: A style's slug: list the styles comparable to it (same garment, other brands and price tiers), leaving it out. "alternative to gildan 18500" in `query` does the same.

cheaper_than.description: A style's slug: the comparable styles priced below it.

youth_and_adult.description: Only styles a team can order in both kids' and adult sizes: one style whose sizes span both, or one of a manufacturer's matching youth/adult pair (e.g. Gildan 5000 and 5000B).

sort.description: Order of results. Default: relevance with a query, popular without one.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Details for one product, by slug (from search_catalog) or by any of its variant SKUs: description, colors with images and availability, sizes, the size chart (garment measurements), fabric specs, and how well it takes each decoration method (screen print, DTG, embroidery, sublimation, heat-transfer vinyl, discharge, DTF). Pass `color` to also get that color's sizes, each with its SKU and availability.

sku.description: A variant SKU from get_product (called with a color).

color.description: A color name exactly as listed in `colors`.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: Whether one variant is available now: in_stock, low (a dozen or fewer), out_of_stock, or unknown. Pass its SKU, or the product slug with color and size.

sku.description: A variant SKU from get_product (called with a color).

slug.description: Product slug, with color and size.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Exact prices for a set of SKUs and quantities, as the Standard Blanks cart would charge them: each line's unit price (set by its style's total units), the merchandise subtotal, shipping, and the total before tax. Pass ship_to_zip for that ZIP's shipping and estimated delivery dates (estimates, not guarantees); add need_by (YYYY-MM-DD) with it to learn whether the order is estimated to arrive by that date, and which lines would miss it; without a ZIP, shipping assumes a contiguous-US address and no dates are given. Sales tax is calculated at checkout. Creates nothing.

sku.description: A variant SKU from get_product (called with a color).

need_by.description: Date the order is needed by, YYYY-MM-DD. Answered only with ship_to_zip.

tools.name: build_cart
tools.description: Create a cart of SKUs and quantities and return a link (claimUrl) that opens it in the shopper's cart on standardblanks.com, where they review it and check out. It does not take payment or place an order. Give the shopper the link. Limits: 40 lines, $5,000 of merchandise; the link works for 7 days.

sku.description: A variant SKU from get_product (called with a color).

note.description: Optional context for our support team, e.g. what the order is for. Not shown on the cart.
